headline: Taxi drivers' protest in Milan, Architect@Work and Forum Retail at MiCo, Tokio Hotel at Assago

linate: Some extra business arrivals for the trade shows; allow time if taxis are scarce.
weather: Overcast, light rain late morning and afternoon, 10–12°C

headline: Last day of Architect@Work and Forum Retail in the week's heaviest rain, on the eve of the ATM strike

linate: M4 at risk outside guaranteed hours; ISF delegates start arriving; book a taxi early.
